name: Bagel Cafe
description: Breakfast-and-lunch spot known for daily-baked bagels, breakfast sandwiches, and deli sandwiches like the Reuben and turkey club.

name: Barren's Distillery + Restaurant
description: Waterfront distillery and restaurant on the wharf overlooking Camden Harbor, pairing house-made spirits with a locally sourced menu. Seasonal, open May through October.

name: Buttermilk Kitchen at Marriner's
description: All-day breakfast and brunch restaurant on Main Street known for scratch biscuits and Southern-inflected morning fare, in the storefront that was formerly Marriner's Restaurant.

name: Camden Cone
description: Seasonal ice cream stand scooping Round Top ice cream and frozen yogurt in more than 30 flavors, a few blocks from Camden's harbor.

name: Camden Deli
description: A Camden landmark since 1985 serving gourmet deli sandwiches, homemade soups, and scratch-baked desserts, with a rooftop deck overlooking Camden Harbor.

name: Camden House of Pizza
description: Pizzeria and Greek restaurant serving pizza, gyros, pasta, salads, and burgers, with beer and wine available for 21+.

name: Franny's Bistro
description: Neighborhood bistro serving a New American menu of small plates and entrees, known for mussels, halibut specials, and calamari. Extensive wine and cocktail list; walk-ins accommodated depending on availability.

name: Fresh & Co
description: Small, chef-owned dinner restaurant near the harbor serving an eclectic, globally-inspired menu built around locally sourced ingredients.

name: Hartstone Inn Restaurant & Lounge
description: Restaurant and lounge at the Hartstone Inn serving coastal Maine seafood with locally sourced, seasonally rotating menus. Live music Thursday evenings.

name: Long Grain
description: Asian fusion restaurant drawing on Thai, Vietnamese, Singaporean, and Chinese cooking, with small-batch sauces made without preservatives. Dine-in and takeout.

name: Natalie's at Camden Harbour Inn
description: Fine dining restaurant at the Camden Harbour Inn, serving a modern take on New England cuisine sourced from Maine fishing boats, farms, and gardens. Dining room and heated porches overlook Camden Harbor.

name: Peter Ott's on the Water
description: Seasonal seafood restaurant on Bayview Landing overlooking Camden's inner harbor, open spring through fall.

name: Salt Wharf
description: Waterfront restaurant and rooftop bar serving coastal seafood. The rooftop and patio offer a casual menu including lobster rolls, while the dining room below serves a more chef-driven menu.

name: Villager Cafe
description: Community breakfast-and-lunch cafe that also houses the Midcoast Villager newsstand, serving pancakes, breakfast sandwiches, and tacos.

name: Vintage Room
description: Cocktail bar and small-plates restaurant on the ground floor of the 16 Bay View hotel, serving globally-influenced shareable dishes alongside craft cocktails and a curated wine list.

name: Winona's
description: Intimate 20-seat restaurant serving chef-driven small plates that change every two weeks, built around seasonal Maine coast ingredients. Open kitchen with curated wine pairings; reservations recommended.

name: Zoot Coffee
description: Cafe and on-site coffee roaster serving espresso drinks and a light breakfast and lunch menu near the harbor.

name: 13 Oak
description: Wood-fired restaurant serving French-inflected comfort food with Maine seafood at the center. Located in a historic downtown space, features an approachable-yet-elevated menu with items ranging from wood-fired pasta to expertly prepared seafood.

name: Ada's Kitchen
description: Casual Italian restaurant serving handmade pasta and pizza alongside craft cocktails.

name: Alaskan Captain
description: Seafood market and takeout specializing in frozen prepared meals and fresh seafood products. Founded by a former Alaska Bering Sea commercial fisheries captain, features shrimp scampi, garlic butter shrimp, lobster mac and cheese, and scallops.

name: Archer's on the Pier
description: Waterfront seafood restaurant featuring fresh lobster rolls, local seafood, pasta, and salads. House-made desserts and extensive wine selection with outdoor deck seating overlooking the harbor.

name: Atlantic Baking Company
description: European-style bakery and cafe featuring artisan breads and French pastries made fresh daily. Also serves breakfast, soups, and desserts.

name: Cafe Grazie
description: Daytime cafe and market in the former Wiggins' Meat Market. Offers breakfast sandwiches, burritos, frittata, porridge, pasta, focaccia, cardamom buns, and fresh pastries from Double Grazie bakery. Serves Tandem coffee and afternoon spritzes.

name: Clan MacLaren
description: Sandwich shop serving cold sandwiches, lobster rolls in season, panini, salads, and seafood chowder. Bread sourced from Borealis Breads in Waldoboro. Vegan and gluten-free options available.

name: Claws
description: Casual lobster shack on Rockland Harbor with picnic-table seating, serving lobster rolls and fresh-caught seafood.

name: Dry Dock Restaurant
description: Waterfront pub on Rockland Harbor serving American fare and seafood, including lobster rolls, with indoor and outdoor harborside seating. Formerly Eclipse of the Pearl.

name: High Tide
description: Beer bar and restaurant featuring fresh local seafood, Mediterranean dishes, and burgers. Menu includes lobster bisque, baked stuffed lobster, lobster mac and cheese, lobster rolls, and salads with a curated selection of local beers and wines.

name: Hill's Seafood Co.
description: Family-owned sit-down restaurant serving fresh seafood in a casual, no-reservations atmosphere.

name: Home Kitchen Cafe
description: Scratch-made breakfast and lunch diner with an on-site bakery, plus seasonal outdoor seating.

name: In Good Company
description: Wine bar in a renovated former bank serving tapas-style small plates and full entrees alongside an extensive wine list.

name: Lemon Bar
description: Intimate wine and cocktail bar with a sweet approach to spirits. Features a curated selection of wines, craft cocktails, and small snacks.

name: Lulu's Ice Cream & Gelato
description: Over 25 years of serving homemade ice cream and authentic Italian gelato with rotating seasonal flavors. Cozy alley location behind Fog Bar with shaded outdoor seating. About eight ice cream flavors and around 15 gelato options available.

name: Main Street Markets
description: Local foods market and cafe in downtown Rockland offering locally sourced provisions, prepared foods, lunch specials, salads, and smoothies. Full-service cafe with indoor and outdoor patio seating.

name: Mulligan's Pub
description: Drinks and dining with a view of the beautiful Rockland golf course.

name: Newty's Ice Cream
description: Second Newty's location, a hand-scooped ice cream and espresso shop in a downtown Main Street storefront. Opened May 2026, alongside the original walk-up shack on the South End waterfront.

name: North Beacon Oyster
description: Cozy oyster and raw bar with a rotating selection of local oysters, plus a few non-seafood options.

name: Olive Rose Chocolates
description: Handmade chocolate shop and small cafe with open production kitchen next to 250 Main Hotel. Produces caramels, truffles, buttercreams, buttercrunch, fudge, and marshmallows. Also serves coffee from Blue Hill roasted beans. Named after Olive Rose, the first woman elected to public office in the United States.

name: Park Street Grille
description: Family-owned neighborhood bar and grill with a "Maine Meets Mexico" menu of lobster rolls, enchiladas, and margaritas.

name: Primo
description: Farm-to-table fine dining with a daily-changing seasonal menu sourced from the restaurant's own on-site farm.

name: Rock City Cafe
description: Worker-owned cafe and espresso bar serving specialty coffee, house-baked pastries, and quick breakfast and lunch.

name: Rock Harbor Pub and Brewery
description: Pub and in-house brewery pouring house-made beers alongside seafood, burgers, and other pub fare.

name: Rockland Cafe
description: Bustling downtown diner serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, known for its Maine seafood specials.

name: Roselyn Thai Fine Cuisine
description: Authentic Thai cuisine — curries, noodle and rice dishes, and appetizers — in a casual, welcoming dining room on Route 1.

name: Ruckus Donuts
description: Family-owned donut shop featuring fresh, made-to-order brioche-style yeast donuts with creative daily flavors. Also serves coffee. Arrive early, as selection often sells out.

name: Rustica Cucina Italiana
description: Housemade pasta, bread, and traditional Italian plates in a spacious downtown dining room, made from scratch since 2006.

name: Sammy's Deluxe
description: Fresh, straightforward American comfort food using seasonal ingredients and locally sourced items. Simple, high-value cooking featuring innovative dishes in the style of elevated homestyle fare.

name: Suzuki's Sushi Bar
description: Sushi and sashimi bar prizing seasonal, local seafood, with no fried or grilled dishes on the menu.

name: The Idle Hour
description: Bar and restaurant on Main Street opened by longtime Ada's Kitchen staff, serving seafood-forward pub fare including oysters, chowder, and fish and chips alongside cocktails.

name: Trackside Station
description: Full-service bar and grill in Rockland's historic former train station, hosting everything from casual meals to weddings.

name: Tuck & Roll
description: Breakfast and lunch food truck specializing in waffles. Offers creative waffle dishes, gluten-free options with separate preparation equipment, and fresh-roasted coffee.

name: Wasses Hot Dogs
description: Take-out stand offering grilled hot dogs and burgers. Uses peanut oil. Cash only.

name: Waterworks Restaurant
description: Downtown pub in a historic former waterworks building, serving fresh Maine seafood and comfort-food classics with a patio just off Main Street.

name: The Black Harpoon
description: Family-friendly seafood restaurant and bar in Port Clyde featuring locally sourced fish, steaks, and seasonal specials. Casual dining with lively evening bar scene.
address: 202 Drift Inn Rd, Port Clyde ME 04855

name: Causeway Restaurant
description: Year-round dining room and deck with ocean views over the Spruce Head coastline, serving local seafood.

name: McLoons Lobster Shack
description: Waterfront lobster shack across from a working lobster wharf, with harbor and sunset views from the dining deck.

name: Squid Ink Coffee
description: Dock-side coffee café in Port Clyde with espresso drinks and pastries, featuring outdoor seating with harbor views and views of passing lobster boats.
address: 6 Cold Storage Rd, Port Clyde ME 04855

name: Tenants Harbor General Store
description: Full-service general store with deli counter serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner sandwiches, wraps, and salads. Also offers Maine-roasted coffee, meat and seafood counter, and wine selection.

name: Athens Pizzeria
description: Family-owned pizzeria serving Greek specialties like gyros and spanakopita alongside pizza, pasta, and subs.

name: Crooked Spoon
description: Intimate Italian restaurant featuring handmade fresh pasta, focaccia, and seasonal dishes paired with craft cocktails and carefully curated wines. Limited dinner hours.

name: Dorman's Dairy Dream
description: Beloved seasonal ice cream stand making its own ice cream in-house, with flavors from Maine blueberry to grapenut.

name: FlipSide Coffee
description: Beloved downtown Thomaston gathering spot with thoughtfully sourced coffee, espresso drinks, and a menu of breakfast and lunch items. Wheelchair accessible with covered patio and local art on display.

name: Honey's Fried Chicken Palace
description: Casual fried chicken spot specializing in hand-trimmed chicken thighs seasoned in a custom blend of 12 herbs and spices, served with 17+ housemade sauces on brioche buns. Opened April 2025.

name: Hot Hill Tavern
description: Neighborhood tavern serving pub fare with Puerto Rican-influenced specialties, plus live music and pool tables.

name: Ka Chai Thai Street Food
description: Authentic Bangkok-style Thai street food using traditional recipes and fresh ingredients. Offers takeout and delivery, with vegetarian options available.

name: Laurel's Dolce Vita
description: Italian bakery and café in a historic 1870s firehouse featuring small-batch pastries baked fresh daily. Specializes in authentic Italian pastries, fresh pasta, and artisan breads using locally sourced ingredients.

name: Station 118 BBQ
description: Smoked pulled pork, brisket, and ribs with homemade sides and a full bar in a casual dining room.

name: The Uproot Pie Co & The Carriage House
description: Wood-fired pizza restaurant in a 19th-century carriage house. Offers seasonal pizza menus, salads, small bites, and a rotating beer and wine selection. Hosts pizza-making classes and special events.

name: Thomaston Cafe
description: Casual lunch-and-dinner cafe known for weekly specials like Prime Rib Wednesday and Thursday burger night.

name: Wasses Hot Dogs
description: Take-out stand offering grilled hot dogs and burgers. Uses peanut oil. Cash only.

name: The Zack Shack
description: Roadside food truck serving seafood and takeout classics; the current New County Rd lot has been reported for sale, so location may change.
